name: Pokemon Stadium 2 Overworld Models - Gold/Silver (Gen 2)
description: Standalone Gold/Silver Gen-2 voxel + Stadium 2 mod. v0.1.85 adds IN-WORLD 3D BATTLES: normal Gold battles are staged on the exact voxel overworld map/encounter site with Stadium 2 Pokemon models, the map's terrain, trees, buildings, day/night sky and weather behind Gold's native battle UI and logic. It also fixes v0.1.84 true-360 player locomotion so 3D Character Selector skins animate while continuous walking. Retains non-experimental status, camera modes, camera-relative 360 movement, Johto tree fix, all-Pokemon 3D fallback, Skin Selector compatibility and visible START/pause overlays.
